metrics.notes: Rust 1.95 confirmed (rust-toolchain.toml pins stable, active = 1.95.0). std::simd stabilised in Rust 1.89 (portable SIMD). cosine_similarity already has 8-way unrolled accumulator from PR #888 (memory-core/src/embeddings/similarity.rs). cosine_similarity_benchmark.rs exists at benches/ with dims 384/768/1536/3072. HNSW inner loop (hnsw.rs) uses hnsw_lib DistCosine which is the secondary SIMD target. Fallback scalar path preserved via cfg(target_feature) guards. All targets: x86_64 (AVX2), aarch64-apple (NEON), wasm32-unknown-unknown (scalar fallback). Existing tests cover cosine drift < 1e-5. Estimated 2x-4x throughput on 1536-dim vectors. No external crate needed — std::simd only.
